title: TS2Python chart announcement (hello, proto 2)
description: One chart announcing itself, published by EL_Init on the fixed control topic __ts2py__. NOT a data point: it carries no OHLC, no quantity words and no quote. The topic is the discriminator — no `kind` field was added and the point frame is unchanged. It rides its own topic because a consumer subscribes per symbol from a configured list, so a chart on a symbol nobody asked for could not be announced on that symbol's own topic, and that is exactly the case an operator needs told about.

proto.description: Wire protocol version. Still 2: the point frame did not change, so the wire did not. What changed is the DLL ABI, which EL_DllVersion reports as 3.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence for the control topic, counted separately from every symbol's. A lost announcement is as invisible as a lost point without it.

sid.description: Publisher session id, the same value the point frames carry. Ties an announcement to the session that made it, so a consumer can tell a DLL restart from a lost hello.

ts.description: DLL receive clock (UTC epoch seconds) at the moment EL_Init was called. There is no ts_str: a hello is not a bar and has no bar time.

symbol.description: EasyLanguage GetSymbolName, verbatim. Must be read as a string and refused otherwise — a JSON null coerced with str() becomes "None" and registers a chart under a name that reads like a real symbol.

category.description: EasyLanguage Category, verbatim. The key to the semantics.md 3.4 table; 2 = Stock, 4 = Index. The publisher never branches on it.

bar_type.description: EasyLanguage BarType, verbatim. 0 = tick, 1 = intraday minute, 2 = daily.

bar_interval.description: EasyLanguage BarInterval, verbatim. Nothing maps this to a timeframe name and nothing refuses an interval.
